question: nearest river to Vatican
sql: WITH v AS (SELECT geometry FROM countries WHERE name='Vatican' LIMIT 1) SELECT r.name, r.feature_class, ST_Distance_Sphere(v.geometry, r.geometry)/1000 AS km_dist FROM v, rivers r ORDER BY ST_Distance_Sphere(v.geometry, r.geometry) LIMIT 1

question: countries within 500km of White Sea Canal
sql: WITH canal AS (SELECT geometry FROM rivers WHERE name='White Sea Canal' LIMIT 1) SELECT c.name, c.iso_a3, ST_Distance_Sphere(c.geometry, canal.geometry)/1000 AS km_dist FROM countries c, canal WHERE ST_Distance_Sphere(c.geometry, canal.geometry) <= 500000 ORDER BY km_dist

question: 3 closest countries to Ob river
sql: WITH riv AS (SELECT geometry FROM rivers WHERE name='Ob' AND feature_class='River' LIMIT 1) SELECT c.name, c.continent, ST_Distance_Sphere(c.geometry, riv.geometry)/1000 AS km_dist FROM countries c, riv ORDER BY ST_Distance_Sphere(c.geometry, riv.geometry) LIMIT 3

question: nearest 5 rivers to Zambia
sql: WITH z AS (SELECT geometry FROM countries WHERE name_long='Zambia' LIMIT 1) SELECT r.name, r.feature_class, r.scalerank, ST_Distance_Sphere(z.geometry, r.geometry)/1000 AS km_dist FROM rivers r, z ORDER BY ST_Distance_Sphere(z.geometry, r.geometry) LIMIT 5

question: nearest river for each African country
sql: SELECT c.name, nr.name AS nearest_river, ST_Distance_Sphere(c.geometry, nr.geometry)/1000 AS km_dist FROM countries c CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT r.name, r.geometry FROM rivers r ORDER BY ST_Distance_Sphere(c.geometry, r.geometry) LIMIT 1) nr WHERE c.continent='Africa' ORDER BY c.name

question: rivers within 100km of high income OECD countries
sql: SELECT DISTINCT r.name, r.feature_class, c.name AS country FROM countries c JOIN rivers r ON ST_Distance_Sphere(c.geometry, r.geometry) <= 100000 WHERE c.income_grp='1. High income: OECD' ORDER BY r.name
